items.title: The first factor of a DM, quasi-DM, separated or quasi-separated composite has the same property
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects four permanence assertions: if a composite of morphisms of algebraic stacks is DM, quasi-DM, separated or quasi-separated (with the additional hypothesis that the diagonal of the second factor has the same property in the last two cases), then the first factor has that property (author lemma at source lines 928-940, label lemma-compose-after-separated). The proof (source lines 942-1058) uses the same factorisation of the diagonal of the composite in all four parts, reduces to morphisms of algebraic spaces by testing against schemes mapping to the middle fibre product, applies the permanence statement for algebraic spaces to the outer composite, checks the relevant property of the inner map by a diagram of 2-cartesian squares, and reads the conclusion off the identification of the resulting fibre product with the diagonal of the original morphism (proof lines 953-1057). The uniform diagonal computation across the four cases is the content. H3.
